title: Reset your password
subtitle: Enter the work email you sign in with. If an account exists, the link is on its way.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.subtitle: We sent a reset link to {{email}}. It expires in 30 minutes and can only be used once.

errors.generic: We couldn't send the link just now. Check your connection and try again.

note: The link works once and expires after 30 minutes. If you didn't ask for it, no action is needed — your password stays as it is.

slab.title: Back in two minutes.
slab.blurb: We email a single-use link to your work address. It works once, then it stops.
